acceptance: Adapter renders launch inputs, starts the game, and reports exit/failure.

implementation_review.launch_rendering: src/Bindery.Ra2.Adapter/SpawnIniRenderer.cs validates executable/map/player values, rejects control-character injection, and renders deterministic multiplayer INI input.
implementation_review.process_boundary: src/Bindery.Ra2.Adapter/SpawnerBoundary.cs exposes ISpawnerBoundary and keeps real process integration Windows-only.
implementation_review.lifecycle: src/Bindery.Ra2.Adapter/ProcessLifecycle.cs reports Ready, Started, Exited, and Failed transitions and returns the process exit code.
implementation_review.failure_handling: Start failures report Failed with a non-secret exception type before rethrowing; non-zero process exits report Failed with the exit code.

verification.local_dotnet_build: not-run: dotnet shim has no configured local SDK

boundary.reason: Process lifecycle and Windows spawner semantics are coordinator-owned cross-platform behavior; no worker packet was used.
